review_scope: Narrow independently authored factual records, not copied tables, filing prose, photographs or illustrations
copyright_facts_basis: Facts are distinguished from protected expression and creative compilation. Absence of an express factual-data licence is not by itself a copyright prohibition.
not_an_automatic_clearance: Source-specific access terms and possible database restrictions must also be resolved. SEC hosting does not turn issuer-authored exhibits into government works.

project:eqix:MD5.reason: City/HQ CC0 facts and minimal SEC issuer identifiers have a reuse basis; the project/opening/Owned-column facts still rely on corporate sources with copying/republication terms. Need a documented narrow factual-reuse decision covering source access/database conditions, or permission/independent cleared source. No presentation/table republished.

project:eqix:SV18.reason: Same bounded-facts approach as MD5. Corporate-site/presentation access conditions remain unresolved; no automatic licence asserted for corporate facts just because their expression is rewritten.

project:eqix:SG6.reason: Opening and scope-qualified capacity/investment facts are separately authored facts, but exact corporate-source access/reuse conditions remain unresolved. No press-release prose, table or image is redistributed.

project:coresite:DE3.reason: Project/specification facts and conflicting areas are independently recorded; no copying of a brochure or photo. Commercial source/access terms or approved factual-reuse basis still needs a decision; unavailable guessed privacy-policy URL is not clearance.

project:coresite:NY3.reason: Launch plus current service facility source establish operating exposure. Public factual reuse has no automatic permission inferred from directory availability; source access/reuse basis remains unresolved. No website material or image copied.

cleared_components: Wikidata CC0 city/HQ reference facts, with attribution and approximate precision
Narrow SEC issuer/ticker/security identifiers already approved by owner, not issuer filing text
